_about: Regression for a lua_loop stack overflow caused by a command that queues itself through smelt.cmd.run. Nested callback flushing recursively started a fresh deferred-command drain, so each invocation reset the work limit instead of returning to the bounded outer drain.
_fix: Keep deferred Lua command draining non-reentrant so self-queued commands are processed iteratively and stop at the per-flush command limit.
